headline: Cranston police say a network intrusion took their systems offline; Reported, single source.
summary: New incident page. Sources read: NBC 10 News (WJAR) and The Providence Focal (Tier 2). Both repeat one police statement, so they count as one source and nothing here is Confirmed. Main question: Reported. Ransom demand, personal data and attacker: Not established; the police refusal to pay is not a report that a demand was made. A rewrite on a small ad network and an incident-tracker profile were seen in search and not used. Status monitoring. Privacy check done: no names, bylines, handles or contact details.
